sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details unauthorized card-not-present activity involving customer C11309 and card C11309-K1. On November 9, 2016 at 01:46:20 UTC, online transaction 3442910 was initiated for $150.09 in region 330 for product H. The transaction was conducted from device D007351 (profile SM-J327T1 Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 65.0 for android | 1280x720) marked as New to the account, utilizing anonymous.com email addresses. Device D007351 is directly linked to confirmed fraud cases CC-5527 on card C10979-K1 and CC-5533 on card C07247-K1. Additionally, device D007351 was concurrently operated across multiple compromised accounts within 24 hours, generating transaction 3440243 ($150.06) on card C01629-K1 on November 8, 2016 and transaction 3442995 ($150.04) on card C07212-K2 on November 9, 2016. Card C11309-K1 has been compromised in 20 prior confirmed fraud cases, and the cardholder has no legitimate historical activity in region 330. Direct suspicious exposure on the subject card is $150.09, representing an active cross-card fraud pattern. Card C11309-K1 was blocked to mitigate risk, connected cards were placed under active monitoring, and this report is submitted in accordance with Bank Secrecy Act and FinCEN suspicious activity reporting standards.

stop_reason: The investigation concluded under Policy Section 6 because the fraud probability reached a decisive 0.95, well above the 0.85 threshold, supported by multiple independent lines of evidence including prior confirmed fraud on device D007351, concurrent multi-card exploitation, and 20 prior confirmed compromises on the card, rendering additional evidence collection unnecessary.
